cypher: MATCH (r:DLRepository)-[:DL_CONTAINS_FILE]->(f:DLFile) WHERE r.dataset=$dataset AND r.repo=$repo AND f.path STARTS WITH $prefix WITH r,coalesce(f.extension,'') AS extension,count(f) AS total,collect(f.id) AS ids RETURN extension+': '+toString(total) AS entity,extension+': '+toString(total) AS fact,[r.id]+ids AS evidence_ids ORDER BY entity
